program_image_view.source: interfaces.md:144-158; prepared once, immutable at runtime (security-phase0.md:65)
program_image_view.construction: Only prepare_core produces a ProgramView. admit runs prepare_core and then check_program_view (AD-5). No API admits a caller-supplied ProgramView.

prog.expressions.occurrence: ExprId is the occurrence index: one row per syntactic occurrence, no interning (interfaces.md:49). Preorder, entry first (ExprId 0), then each function body in original function order, children in semantic source order; every child and arm body ExprId is greater than its parent's (MCL design.md:65, 138-141, 154).

prog.occurrences.rule: row i describes ExprId i; root occurrences (entry, function bodies) have the empty path; Entry has no index (MCL design.md:150)

prog.occurrencePaths.rule: Let value 0, body 1; Binary left 0, right 1; Unary operand 0; If cond 0, then 1, else 2; Call argument i at i; Match scrutinee 0, arm k body k+1 (MCL design.md:146-150 F1(b), G2). Each complete path is appended in occurrence order.

prog.children.rule: each Call row's args slice, appended in ExprId order

prog.functions.rule: row index equals sourceTableIndex; original order, duplicate names retained

prog.parameters.rule: parameter slices appended in function order

prog.arms.rule: each Match's arms contiguous, appended in ExprId order

prog.patterns.rule: one pattern row per arm, in source arm order

prog.constants.order: constant subtrees in literal ExprId order, each left-to-right post-order, children before parent, no interning (MCL design.md:156-161 F1(c))
prog.constants.out_of_range: KInt Negative or AboveU128 prepares to U128OutOfRange with zero payload (D-13)

prog.constantFields.rule: a node's field block is appended with the node, after its children (MCL design.md:200 G1)

row.bytes: Text (host metadata; total bytes bounded by layout.capacities.nameBytes)

prog.names.rule: distinct exact names, strictly ascending UTF-8 byte order, containing exactly the names occurring in program syntax including unused code (MCL design.md:128-136 F1(a)); NameId is the index, so NameId equality is name equality; circuit views carry NameId only (schema-types.json:32-35)

program_image_view.declaration_tables: Under DedicatedSorts the view has no types, constructors, constructorFields or matchPlans table. Bounds typeRows, constructorRows, constructorFieldSlots and matchPlanRows are carried in identity only (AD-4). The A node form's builtin rows are a physical layout choice (I/L01-L02), not a core table.

deterministic_order.rule: Three passes in fixed order; the first failing check in pass order, and within a pass in traversal order, is the single reported Tooling value.
deterministic_order.traversal: Occurrence preorder: the entry expression, then for each function in table order its name, its parameter names in order, then its body. Within an expression node: the node's own names (Var binder, Let binder, Call functionName, each arm's pattern binders x then y in arm order) before its children in semantic source order.
deterministic_order.pass_A_features: For adapters from a richer AST only: the first generic or financial construct in traversal order yields UnsupportedFeature{feature, locator}. CoreProgram cannot express such constructs, so pass A is vacuous for CoreProgram.
deterministic_order.pass_B_names: Collect distinct names in traversal order. At the first discovery of each distinct name, first report CapacityNotAdmitted{NameRows, needed: Exact(distinct_count+1), limit: nameRows} if accepting it would exceed nameRows; otherwise report CapacityNotAdmitted{NameBytes, needed: Exact(cumulative_distinct_bytes+name_bytes_len), limit: nameBytes} if accepting it would exceed nameBytes. Duplicate occurrences cause no check and no clone. Membership is held as borrowed references in a deterministic ordered set; after a successful pass the names are materialized once each in ascending order, which is the sorted result. This preparation work is unmetered trusted-host work under GD-R7-A: no preparation-work unit, cap, counter, PreparationReport, CapacityKind, Tooling variant, Bounds field, or LayoutCapacities field is added.
pass_C_emission: C1 expressions and occurrences in occurrence preorder: each emitted row checks codeRows; each Call checks args count <= maxArity (CapacityNotAdmitted{MaxArity})
C2 children slots in ExprId order: codeChildSlots
C3 arms then their pattern rows in ExprId order: matchArmRows, then patternRows per arm
C4 occurrence paths in occurrence order: occurrencePathSlots
C5 functions in table order: functionRows; each function checks parameter count <= maxArity, then its parameters: parameterSlots
C6 constants in literal ExprId order, left-to-right post-order: constantNodes per node, constantFieldSlots per field block
deterministic_order.incremental: every check happens at the emitting row, refusing at the first overflow, never after a complete traversal (F5)
